question.text: Number of moles of ions produced by complete dissociation of one mole of Mohr's salt in water is

solution.text:
Hint : Mohr's salt $\mathrm{FeSO}_4 \cdot\left(\mathrm{NH}_4\right)_2 \mathrm{SO}_4 \cdot 6 \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$
$\mathrm{FeSO}_4 \cdot\left(\mathrm{NH}_4\right)_2 \mathrm{SO}_4 \cdot 6 \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{Fe}^{+2}+2 \mathrm{NH}_4^{+}+2 \mathrm{SO}_4^{-2}$
5 ions produced on dissociation
